verdict.rationale: Calendly documents connecting multiple calendars and checking them for conflicts before someone books, and community users praise checking multiple calendars for open slots. That only protects Calendly's own booking availability. No evidence shows Calendly writing busy blocks from a work calendar into a personal calendar (or the reverse) to keep them in step, so this is an adjacent feature, not the story's capability.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, busy blocks sync between my work and personal calendars automatically so all my schedules stay in step
